question: Do deposited GSE160217 sample identities and matrices qualify the planned acute colon contrasts?
decision: Qualify the RNA input and determine whether count-model reconstruction can proceed.
strongest_rival: Incorrect label mapping, duplicate libraries or technical rather than biological replication.
discriminator: Join GEO attributes to all six table columns; check integer counts, identifiers and reported biological units without estimating treatment effects.
exposure_record: Published Fig. 6 and main source methods read; GEO sample titles and headers inspected before freeze. No expression contrast has been calculated.
biological_unit: Source-reported independent colon sample; metadata records are not new biological units.
nesting_and_overlap: Six libraries reuse the paper samples. qPCR technical triplicates supply no independent RNA-seq units.
population_and_selection: All six GSE160217 deposited libraries, two per named treatment; no selection by expression.
contrast: Metadata qualification of WT, B3 and PBS column mapping; no biological contrast in this stage.
endpoint: Source identity, integer count validity, library totals, symbol ambiguity and zero rows.
methods: Standard-library gzip/CSV parser; exact column and annotation joins; fail on duplicate Ensembl IDs, negative/nonfinite/noninteger counts or unexpected group sizes.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample exclusions; missing metadata recorded explicitly; ambiguous symbols retained for later qualification.
multiplicity: No significance tests in metadata work.
precision_basis: No biological estimate or uncertainty interval is computed.
interpretation_limit: Matrix and metadata validity do not establish independence beyond the original report or causal identification.
stop_rule: Fail on schema/count/join defects; preserve run failure and amend prospectively.
amendment_reason: Initial preflight rejected CRLF checkout bytes against LF code hash, before any run directory was created. Preserve exact LF bytes; explicitly bind synthetic tests. No scientific design change.
